items.s: Rain CEO Farooq Malik said more than 100,000 merchants accept stablecoins unknowingly, with transactions settling through Visa in three days.

items.h: Winklevoss-Backed Cypherpunk Launches 'World's Largest' Zcash Mining Fleet

items.h: Omnichain Launchpad Printr Shuts Down, Cancels Token Launch And Airdrop
items.s: Printr said it will cease all operations by Aug. 31 and will not hold the token generation event or airdrop it had promised. The launchpad raised $4.5 million last October and collected 84% of its lifetime fees in a single month.

items.h: Ansem Launches Site Where Teams Buy His Attention With Airdrops
items.s: Projects launching on ansem.io hand at least 3% of supply to holders of his memecoin and burn $ANSEM to rank higher. Every coin created there is a pump.fun token.

items.h: Deel Takes Its DLUSD Stablecoin Wallet to More Than 80 Countries
items.s: The payroll platform's dollar balance, issued through Stripe's Bridge and settled on Tempo, is now live across Latin America, Africa, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific. The US, UK, EU and Australia remain excluded.

items.h: Neynar Seeks a New Owner for Farcaster Seven Months After Buying It
items.s: Protocol fees fell from $35.43 million in the first quarter to $376,740 so far in the third, according to DefiLlama. Neynar says it will return most of its remaining balance sheet and its team will disband.

items.h: Search Interest in Prediction Markets Falls 83% From Its World Cup Peak as Kalshi Pulls Away
items.s: Google Trends set its five-year high for "prediction market" the week the 2026 World Cup opened, and its single-day high on the day of the final. Category volume hit a record in July. August is pacing lower on both, and Polymarket is falling behind Kalshi faster than the mindshare data suggests.

items.h: Treasury Proposes Rules for How GENIUS Act Stablecoin Licensing Works

items.h: Compound Foundation Names Coinbase And Anchorage Alumni To Run $52 Million Institutional Push
items.s: The DAO approved the two-year budget in May with 1.88 million COMP in favor and none against. Compound holds about $1.2 billion in deposits, against Aave's $14.8 billion.

items.h: Stripe Is Acquiring AI Router OpenRouter for +$8B
items.s: OpenRouter's founder built OpenSea, then built "Stripe for AI." Now Stripe is buying the company in a massive deal.
